name: Transfer Student
source:
The protagonist of the game and the only male student at Kimisaki Academy. His step-sister, [url=/c98213]Anzu[/url], used to be enrolled at the school, but transferred before he enrolled. He looks very similiar to her.

He and Anzu are childhood friends with [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url].
